metaDescription: Order custom set luggage accessories in bulk. Matching passport wallets and card sets for corporate travel gifts. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need coordinated travel accessories for corporate gifts or employee onboarding, custom set luggage accessories offer a polished solution. Sets like RFID-blocking passport wallets paired with matching card wallets provide both security and brand consistency. These bundles simplify gifting by ensuring recipients get a complete, matching set rather than mismatched pieces. Perfect for trade show giveaways or executive travel kits, these sets can be debossed or screen printed with your logo.
heroAltText: Custom set luggage accessories with matching RFID passport wallet and card wallet for corporate travel gifts
